hero.sub: IMMIO automatically captures listings from Willhaben & Immoscout24 via email, calculates returns in real-time, and guides you through the entire buying process.
hero.note: No credit card · No commitments · 2 weeks Pro free

problem.label: The problem
problem.sub: Most private investors juggle search agents, Excel, browser tabs and sticky notes. Nothing is connected. Decisions get lost.
problem.card1Body: Every property gets its own spreadsheet. Formulas get copied, errors creep in. No comparison possible.
problem.card2Body: Dozens of notifications daily. Interesting properties get buried in the inbox — often before you ever see them.
problem.card3Body: From viewing to notary: no pipeline, no overview, no memory of decisions made.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.sub: Three steps. No setup. Fully automatic.
howItWorks.step1Body: You get a personal IMMIO address. Simply forward your Willhaben and Immoscout24 search agent emails there. No scraping, no terms violations.
howItWorks.step2Body: IMMIO parses every email and extracts price, size, location, rooms and the original listing link — automatically, in seconds.
howItWorks.step3Body: Dashboard, ROI calculator, buying funnel and Finder in one portal. All data stays attached to the property.

features.label: Features
features.sub: Four modules that work together — from first email to purchase completion.
features.feat1Body: Tile and table view, instant search, filter by platform, price and size. All data from your search agents — structured on one screen.
features.feat2Body: Purchase costs, financing, cashflow, gross/net rental yield, return on equity. All calculations locally in the browser — no server latency.
features.feat3Body: Kanban board with 8 stages. Drag & drop, average prices per column. Every property guided through the process.
features.feat4Body: Tinder-like interface for rapid pre-selection. Left: not relevant. Right: interested. Down: open analysis. Up: original listing.

section7.title: 7. Processing of contact data of real-estate agents and listing parties
section7.intro: When you save a property in IMMIO — whether by forwarding a search-agent email, pasting a URL from a property portal, uploading an Exposé, or entering data manually — we may process contact data of the person responsible for the listing. This data includes:
section7.purposeText: This contact data is stored solely to enable you to contact the listing party in the course of your property search. It is visible only to you and is not shared platform-wide or with any other user.
section7.basisIntro: Processing is carried out on the basis of legitimate interest under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. We have conducted a balancing assessment as required by that provision and conclude that the rights of the data subject do not override the processing because:
basisItems: the data is professional contact information already published on the source listing;
the processing is consistent with industry-standard practice in property purchase preparation;
the data is stored in your private user account and is not redistributed;
no automated outreach, marketing, or profiling is performed.
section7.basisFooter: The underlying Legitimate Interest Assessment (LIA) is documented internally and is available on request from the supervisory authority.
section7.sourceText: The contact data originates from the listing itself — from the forwarded search-agent email, from the listing portal's web page, from your uploaded Exposé PDF (via AI extraction), or from your manual entry.
section7.recipientsIntro: The data is stored exclusively on our technical service provider's servers (Supabase, EU region). No transfer to third parties takes place. In particular:
recipientsItems: the data is not used for marketing communication to the agents or listing parties concerned;
the data is not aggregated or published platform-wide;
the data is not used to train AI models.
section7.retentionText: Contact data is bound to the corresponding property record in your account and is deleted together with that record when you remove the property from your account or delete your user account.
section7.userRightsText: You can view, edit, or delete the stored agent contact data at any time via the editing function in your account.
section7.subjectRightsHeading: Rights of the data subject (agent or listing party)
section7.subjectRightsIntro: Persons whose contact data is stored in our system have the following rights under GDPR:
section7.subjectRightsContact: To exercise these rights, please contact
section7.subjectRightsContactSuffix: (or the postal address listed in our Impressum). Upon receipt of a valid request, the relevant data will be deleted or corrected within the statutory time limit; confirmation will follow by email.
section7.draftNotice: Note: this clause is currently under legal review. IMMIO is not yet publicly launched — this text serves as the binding boilerplate during the tester phase.

tour.heading: Take the tour again
tour.description: Click below to re-run the 1-minute orientation tour. It highlights each main section of IMMIO and where to come for help.

1.title: Welcome to IMMIO
1.body: This 1-minute tour shows you what's where. You can re-run it any time from the Help page.

2.body: Your IMMIO email address lives here. Forward your existing Willhaben, ImmoScout24, and other search-agent emails to it — the Sources list shows which portals have started sending. Set up forwarding from the Help page.

3.body: Your Funnel. Properties move left-to-right through stages as you investigate them. Drag cards between columns.

4.body: Finder — Tinder for Real Estate. Fast-swipe through new listings — forwarded emails and scraped listings together — to triage them. Right to investigate further in your Funnel, left to dismiss, up to view the listing, down to analyse the property.

5.body: Discover. Every scraped listing in Austria. Pre-configured filters (by Bundesland, by search-agent source) sit alongside your own saved filters — stack them to narrow what you see.

6.body: Click any property to see full details — analysis tools, ROI calculator, document storage, and due-diligence checks. The house icon on a card adds it to your Funnel to start investigating.

7.body: Use this button to report problems or request improvements. We read every piece of feedback.

8.body: When you need help — including how to set up email forwarding — come back here. The tour can be re-run from this page.

gettingStarted.heading: Where do I start?
gettingStarted.intro: Two paths into IMMIO: the recommended path uses email forwarding (most users). An alternative path lets you add properties manually if you don't have search agents configured.

step1.detail: see the section below. Once configured, search-agent emails from Willhaben, ImmoScout24, and others will start landing in your IMMIO funnel automatically.

step2.detail: while you wait for the first emails to arrive. Every scraped listing in Austria is filterable here. Try the saved filters or set your own criteria.

step3.detail: as properties start flowing in — from your forwarded search agents and the scraped database. Swipe right on anything worth a closer look (it lands in your Funnel for investigation), swipe left to dismiss the rest. Don't deliberate during triage — the Funnel is where you slow down and analyse.

step4.detail: and click into them to run an analysis. The ROI calculator handles Rental, Flip, and Owner-occupied scenarios. The Dossier tab holds documents and AI-extracted facts. The Due Diligence tab runs six legal/structural checks against Austrian statute.

forwarding.heading: How email forwarding works
forwarding.preamble:
You have a personal IMMIO address: shown both on your Dashboard (in the Sources tile) and in your Settings page. The format is user_xxxxxxxx@mail.immio.at. When you set up a forwarding filter in your inbox, your existing portal search-agent emails are auto-forwarded to that address, parsed by IMMIO, and turned into properties in your funnel.

The original emails stay in your inbox — forwarding doesn't move them. You can stop or change the forwarding any time by adjusting the filter in your inbox; IMMIO never touches your inbox directly.

Once a forwarding rule is in place, the Sources tile on your Dashboard shows which portals have started sending. A ✓ next to a portal means emails are arriving; ○ means nothing yet. This is your verification surface — if a portal you've set up isn't ticking over to ✓, the forwarding filter isn't matching.

gmail.heading: Gmail
gmail.intro: Create a forwarding address in Gmail and a filter that routes search-agent emails to IMMIO.

steps.1: Open Gmail. Click the Settings cog (top-right) and choose „See all settings“.
steps.3: Click „Add a forwarding address“ and paste your IMMIO address.
steps.4: Gmail will send a confirmation code to your IMMIO address. Watch your Dashboard — the Sources tile will show „1 unread system message — view“ within a minute or two. Click through to read the code, then copy it back into the Gmail prompt to confirm.
steps.5: Back on the Forwarding tab, open „Filters and Blocked Addresses“ → „Create a new filter“.
steps.6: In the „From“ field, enter the sender domain you want to forward (e.g. noreply@willhaben.at for Willhaben, or kein-antwort@email.immobilienscout24.at for ImmoScout24).
steps.7: Click „Create filter“ and check „Forward it to: [your IMMIO address]“.

gmail.verify: To verify: any future search-agent emails will land directly in IMMIO with no further configuration needed. Check the Sources tile on your Dashboard to see which portals have started sending — a ✓ next to a portal means emails are arriving.

outlook.heading: Outlook
outlook.intro: Outlook uses Rules instead of Filters but the structure mirrors Gmail's.

steps.1: Open Outlook on the web (outlook.live.com or outlook.office.com).
steps.2: Click the Settings cog → „View all Outlook settings“.
steps.3: Choose „Mail“ → „Forwarding“ and enable „Enable forwarding“ with your IMMIO address — if you want to forward the entire inbox.
steps.4: Or: „Mail“ → „Rules“ → „Add new rule“. Condition: „From“ contains the portal domain. Action: „Forward to“ your IMMIO address.
steps.5: Save. Outlook sends a confirmation to your IMMIO address.
steps.6: Read the confirmation code in your IMMIO inbox (Sources tile → unread system message) and confirm in Outlook if required.

outlook.gapBody: Outlook's forwarding-confirmation sender is not yet on the IMMIO allowlist (see ADR-020 v1.1). If your confirmation code doesn't appear in the inbox, contact us via the Feedback button — we'll retrieve the code from Railway logs and reply.

apple.heading: Apple Mail / iCloud Mail
apple.intro: Apple Mail (Desktop) and iCloud Mail (Web) use Rules; the editors differ slightly.

steps.1: iCloud Mail (Web): Sign in at icloud.com/mail, click the Settings cog → „Preferences“.
steps.2: Open the „Rules“ tab and click „Add a Rule“.
steps.3: Condition: „If a message is from …“ and enter the sender domain (e.g. noreply@willhaben.at).
steps.4: Action: „Forward to …“ and enter your IMMIO address.
steps.6: Apple Mail (Desktop): Mail → Settings → Rules → Add Rule with the same condition/action.

apple.gapBody: Apple/iCloud's forwarding-confirmation sender is not yet on the IMMIO allowlist (see ADR-020 v1.1). If your confirmation code doesn't appear in the inbox, contact us via the Feedback button — we'll retrieve the code from Railway logs and reply.

feedback.heading: Found a bug? Have a suggestion?
feedback.description:
Use the Feedback button at the bottom-right corner of any page (or, on mobile, Settings → Feedback). Report bugs, request features, or send us improvements. You'll see the status of every report in the „My reports“ tab — we'll update them as we work through them.

We're a two-person team during the tester phase, so reports are read within 24 hours. Critical bugs typically resolved within 2–3 days; we don't send email follow-ups, so check the „My reports“ tab for updates.
